title: How Guyana Is Feeding the Profits of Exxon Mobil, the Largest U.S. Oil Company
summary: Exxon Mobil found a coveted growth engine in Guyana. Now it must navigate Guyana’s fractious politics and a territorial dispute with Venezuela.
